evaluationContract.stageTicketPolicy: Recognize committed tickets as opportunities with unknown results, never assume guaranteed power or use None from the future.
evaluationContract.result: candidate/skip/needs_configuration from evaluateArchetypeNeed; spin/skip/needs_configuration from planArchetypeStage. Required facts missing or invalid raise ArchetypeInputError; no random draw or state mutation.
evaluationContract.skipBehavior: Zero Archetype spins; journal explicit skip and continue Backstory. No NPC/None fake spin, role reward, or Shrek trigger. Raksasa has zero primary/secondary spins in policy 1.0.0.
evaluationContract.missingProfile: Missing approved body, role/event or composition source bindings yields needs_configuration. Siluman requires one selected animal from12, no count/sampling profile. A complete valid role pool with no compatible outcomes skips; invalid required facts or non-positive enabled weights raise an input error.
evaluationContract.filter: Validate approved role event/requirements and final body profile; filter incompatible roles before normalization. Default weight 1; explicit configured positive weights preserved. Valid complete pool with no compatible role skips; missing pool/profile yields needs_configuration.
evaluationContract.limits: No universal power=2/stat=1 eligibility score is adopted. Mythical/Hero comparison budgets remain local design metadata. Potency order is not the later Power Mastery rank.
evaluationContract.idempotence: Commit the plan snapshot once through commitArchetypePlan, atomically with future scheduling. Resume reuses that plan and invocation ID, even after configuration changes. Actual seeded spin/reaction/ledger remain the future engine responsibility.
evaluationContract.inputBoundary: Fixed grants and race-local modifiers are represented by the approved selected subtype/event outcomes. The gate does not inspect or execute the inventory/effect ledger; completed nodes are an engine assertion that Race events have finished.

compositionRules.rule: Resolve both roots and all descendants first. A strong granted package makes the combined character skip. A standalone skip due solely to body fit must be re-evaluated against the explicitly defined combined body; never automatically infer humanoid fusion or let one component name alone deny/enable every role. Two light roots still need aggregate and body review. No per-root Archetype.
examples: Human + Goblin Kacung → candidate spin once
Human + Elf with light Holy → aggregate/body review, not automatic double reward
Symbiote → Raksasa → Abyssal plus second Hybrid root → final aggregate skip under accepted policy
Human + Household → actual composite body review; standalone Household skip does not erase Human/other-source grants or invent a humanoid appliance.

compositionRules.rule: Use the full origin tree and normal origin rewards, then undead body requirements; Human origin can be eligible, Dragon origin remains skip. The Lelembut origin label adds no automatic stat/power upper hand.
Evaluate actual host and takeover together; a skipped/strong host is never requalified by 0% takeover. Low takeover does not create an extra role slot.
All Raksasa components skip from the committed giant binding, without seeing future Size/Cosmic. Policy 1.0.0 creates no primary or secondary Archetype and no deferred Archetype ticket.
Prey race is feeding reference only; never runs prey race eligibility/events or changes character family history.

Exactly one animal spin from twelve approved types, equal base weights (1/12 before modifiers). No count wheel or additional type spin. Normal form humanoid with animal traits, one common transformation bound to that result. No automatic bonus from names; explicit body/role profiles remain required.

Household skip preserves deliberately weak own function, not removal of bonuses from a Hybrid/host/other source. Shrek Growth already committed from real tagged spins remains; no fake skip spin triggers it.
